How it worksPrivacyOpen Haku

Privacy note

This note explains how Haku handles information on this website and in the Telegram Mini App.

Your reading answers

Answers such as your birthday, birth time, birthplace, relationship status, and other reading responses are used only in the Mini App page to calculate and display your story. They are never sent to our server and are not saved in localStorage.

Account information saved with your consent

Only after you check the consent box in the Mini App do we save your Telegram user ID, interface language, Bot used to enter Haku, first and most recent visit times, and the time and version of your consent. We do not save your name, username, or reading answers.

How long information is kept

Account records are automatically deleted 365 days after your last use.

Export or delete your account

At any time, use “Download my data” in the Mini App to export your account record, or “Delete my account” to remove it.

Cookies and external resources

This website does not use cookies and does not load third-party resources. The Mini App uses one necessary login cookie to maintain your session.

IP addresses and server logs

This website and the Mini App are delivered through Cloudflare, and our web server keeps access logs. Both process your IP address to deliver pages and protect the service. The Mini App audit log also stores the IP address and time of administrator sign-ins, failed sign-in attempts, and account data exports. These records never contain your reading answers.

Administrator access and logs

The admin area is limited to named administrator accounts. The system records administrator sign-ins, failed sign-in attempts, sign-outs, and data exports in its audit log.

Contact

For privacy questions, contact us at hello@truesignal.cc.
